name: The Aspic
notes:
Fires at 7:57 of EVERY loop, without exception.

Run it as a social disaster, not a fight. The guests politely ignore it because acknowledging it would embarrass the Duke. Havel serves around it.

270 HP and immune to piercing, slashing, precision and critical hits — a level 12 party with blades cannot meaningfully hurt it, and it re-forms next loop anyway. The trap nobody sees coming: drawing a weapon at the table ruins the toast exactly as thoroughly as the aspic does.

Congealed: fire makes it QUICKENED. A fire party makes it faster. That joke is in the published block.

Fixes: remove it before 7:57 (2 slots + DC 28 Athletics), dispel the preservation (rank 4, GM ruling), or kill the parent in the Cold Room — which is permanent.
terrain: Formal dining room. Long table, sideboard, chandelier.
